# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

Updated the user-visible chemistry surfaces so threshold event summaries now spell out NH3-N and N-basis units, the overview screen restores GH/KH derivation labels plus 7-ion TDS and conductivity estimate units, and API snapshot responses now emit legacy chemistry keys alongside the explicit renamed fields with semantics/scope metadata for the 7-ion estimate.

## Steps

0. [Completed] Inspected the event, snapshot/API, and overview paths called out in the review feedback.
1. [Completed] Changed threshold event summaries to include explicit chemistry bases and added regression coverage for the rendered text.
2. [Completed] Expanded overview chemistry/system copy to show GH/KH derivation labels plus estimated 7-ion TDS and conductivity units.
3. [Completed] Centralized API snapshot serialization behind helpers that emit legacy chemistry aliases and semantics metadata on `/snapshot`, `/snapshot/chemistry`, `/time/step`, `/load`, and scenario-load responses.
4. [Completed] Ran targeted tests and compile checks for the touched crates.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo fmt --all` completed successfully.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test events` passed (7 tests), including the new explicit-unit summary regression.
- `cargo test -p tank_api` passed (2 tests), covering legacy chemistry aliases and 7-ion estimate semantics metadata.
- `cargo check -p tank_tui` completed successfully after the overview copy changes.

## Outstanding Risks

- Repository has unrelated pre-existing modifications in `crates/tank_core/src/invariants.rs`, several `tank_core` tests, and `.ralph-burning/`; they were left untouched.
- The overview copy change was validated with `cargo check -p tank_tui`, but there is still no dedicated render test asserting the exact TUI text.
